description: This file defines a single exported function 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' that processes an array of records related to agent costs, grouping and formatting the data for visualization purposes, specifically for use with Recharts. It includes filtering, categorization, and sorting logic, as well as handling missing or empty category values.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw aggregate records into a grouped dataset suitable for charting, ensuring consistent categories across agents and optionally sorting the agents and categories.
